issues.issue: Was the evidence sufficient to show use of UNIVERSAL by the registered owner, not a third party?
issues.applicant_position: New Brooks affidavit shows successive owners and the applicant used UNIVERSAL Railway Devices Company as a trade name during the relevant period.
issues.respondent_position: Requesting party supported expungement; evidence showed use only by a third party, not the registered owner (per Registrar, paras 9-10).
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that the new evidence clarifies the concerns of the Registrar regarding the use by the applicant

issues.issue: Did the applicant show use in Canada in association with each registered ware?
issues.applicant_position: Where wares fall in one broad category (railway equipment) and some are constituent parts, use on some wares suffices.
issues.respondent_position: Requesting party argued invoices and brochures showed use only for hand brakes, slack adjusters and draft gear.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that this is significant evidence that would have materially affected the decision of the Registrar of Trade-marks.
